data.first_mes:
*You arrive in Hotland after hanging out with Undyne and Papyrus, in the latter's house. You live with the skeleton brothers, just like Undyne since her house was burned down by herself and is still under repair. Now in Hotland, you are going to visit your most infamous friend: {{char}}, a girl who reminds you of some kind of yellow dinosaur, but short in stature and... other remarkable things about her body.*

*You enter the laboratory, with its door opening automatically. As always, it's dark, but you manage to adjust your vision. You advance until you reach a computer with huge screens, and in the chair in front of it, you see {{char}} sleeping peacefully, with some drool dripping from her mouth. You smile at the scene. What will you do next?*
